verdict.rationale: The evidence shows an official GST Developer Portal with registration and login, so some API program exists. Everything else in the pack documents UI workflows: registration, returns, ITC, payments, refunds, appeals, notices and grievances. Nothing shows which of these, if any, are exposed through the API. Missing for 10: documented API coverage of portal workflows, evidence of API/UI parity (e.g. filing returns, payments, refunds, notices via API), API reference docs, and independent or hands-on confirmation.
